# Work Packages: B32 Sport Configuration & Templates

**Inputs**: Design documents from `kitty-specs/041-sport-configuration-templates/`
**Prerequisites**: plan.md ✅, spec.md ✅, research.md ✅, data-model.md ✅, contracts/ ✅, quickstart.md ✅

**Tests**: Only include explicit testing work when stakeholders request it.

**Organization**: Fine-grained subtasks (`Txxx`) roll up into work packages (`WPxx`). Each work package must be independently deliverable and testable.

**Prompt Files**: Each work package references a matching prompt file in `tasks/planned/` generated by `/spec-kitty.tasks`.

**Constitutional Compliance**: All tasks align with Django Core-App Constitution principles.

## Subtask Format: `[Txxx] [P?] Description`
- **[P]** indicates the subtask can proceed in parallel (different files/components).

## Path Conventions
- **Django app**: `src/sport_configuration/`
- **Tests**: `tests/sport_configuration/`
- **Demo frontend**: `demo/src/pages/sport-config/`

---

## Work Package WP01: Django App Scaffold & Models (Priority: P0)

**Goal**: Create `sport_configuration` Django app with Sport, SportConfiguration, and OutfitConfiguration models.
**Independent Test**: Models can be created via Django shell; migrations run successfully.
**Prompt**: `tasks/planned/WP01-django-app-scaffold-and-models.md`

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T001 Create Django app `src/sport_configuration/` with standard structure
- [ ] T002 Create `Sport` model with name, slug, federation_metadata, sport_icon, is_active
- [ ] T003 Create `SportConfiguration` model (1:1 with Sport) with team sizes, positions, formations
- [ ] T004 Create `OutfitConfiguration` model with project FK, outfit_type, colors, sponsor_config
- [ ] T005 Add `sport` FK to Project model with `get_sport()` fallback method
- [ ] T006 Create and run migrations for all models
- [ ] T007 Register models in Django admin
- [ ] T008 Create app README.md

### Constitutional Alignment
- Principle II (Architecture): Single responsibility app for sport configuration
- Principle III (Code Quality): Type hints on all model methods
- Principle XI (Documentation): App README required

### Parallel Opportunities
- T002, T003, T004 can be developed in parallel once app structure exists
- T007, T008 parallel after models complete

### Dependencies
- None (starting package)

### Risks & Mitigations
- Migration conflicts → Run migrations in isolated feature branch
- Project model changes → Use nullable FK with safe migration

---

## Work Package WP02: Service Layer (Priority: P0)

**Goal**: Implement SportValidationService and OutfitLookupService with business logic.
**Independent Test**: Services can validate lineups and lookup outfits via Django shell.
**Prompt**: `tasks/planned/WP02-service-layer.md`

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T009 Create `services/` directory structure
- [ ] T010 Implement `SportValidationService` with lineup validation (warn, not block)
- [ ] T011 Implement position validation with flexible schema (warnings for non-standard)
- [ ] T012 Implement `OutfitLookupService` with Club→Team fallback
- [ ] T013 Create `ValidationResult` dataclass with errors/warnings structure
- [ ] T014 Add type hints and docstrings to all service methods

### Constitutional Alignment
- Principle II (Architecture): Service layer separates business logic from views
- Principle III (Code Quality): Full type hints
- Principle VI (Reliability): Graceful degradation (warnings don't block)

### Parallel Opportunities
- T010-T011 (validation) can develop in parallel with T012 (outfit lookup)

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01 (models must exist)

### Risks & Mitigations
- Validation edge cases → Document all edge cases in service docstrings
- Fallback logic complexity → Unit test all inheritance scenarios

## Work Package WP03: API Endpoints - Sports & Configuration (Priority: P1) 🎯 MVP

**Goal**: Deliver REST API for Sport and SportConfiguration CRUD operations (User Story 1).
**Independent Test**: API endpoints respond correctly via curl/Postman; OpenAPI spec matches.
**Prompt**: `tasks/planned/WP03-api-sports-configuration.md`

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T015 Create `SportSerializer` with nested configuration
- [ ] T016 Create `SportConfigurationSerializer`
- [ ] T017 Implement `SportViewSet` with list, retrieve, create, update actions
- [ ] T018 Implement sport configuration nested endpoint (`/sports/{slug}/configuration/`)
- [ ] T019 Add URL routing in `src/sport_configuration/urls.py`
- [ ] T020 Register URLs in main `urls.py`
- [ ] T021 Add pagination and filtering (is_active, search)

### Constitutional Alignment
- Principle VII (API Design): DRF ViewSets, consistent responses, pagination
- Principle VI (Performance): Pagination for list endpoints

### Parallel Opportunities
- T015-T016 (serializers) can develop in parallel
- T017-T018 (views) after serializers complete

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01 (models) and WP02 (services for validation preview)

### Risks & Mitigations
- Serializer nesting complexity → Test with nested create/update scenarios
- Permission scope → Start with IsAuthenticated, refine later

## Work Package WP04: API Endpoints - Outfit Configuration (Priority: P1)

**Goal**: Deliver REST API for OutfitConfiguration with inheritance-aware responses (User Story 2).
**Independent Test**: Outfit API returns inherited outfits correctly; CRUD operations work.
**Prompt**: `tasks/planned/WP04-api-outfit-configuration.md`

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T022 Create `OutfitConfigurationSerializer` with source indicator (own/inherited)
- [ ] T023 Implement `OutfitConfigurationViewSet` scoped to project
- [ ] T024 Implement inheritance-aware list endpoint (`include_inherited` parameter)
- [ ] T025 Implement outfit retrieval with fallback to parent club
- [ ] T026 Add outfit type validation against sport configuration
- [ ] T027 Add URL routing for project-scoped outfits

### Constitutional Alignment
- Principle VII (API Design): Clear error messages, boundary validation
- Principle II (Architecture): Uses OutfitLookupService for inheritance logic

### Parallel Opportunities
- T022-T23 after WP02 OutfitLookupService complete

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01, WP02

### Risks & Mitigations
- Inheritance edge cases → Test team-without-club scenarios
- Project permission scope → Reuse existing project permission patterns

## Work Package WP05: Validation API Endpoint (Priority: P1)

**Goal**: Deliver lineup and outfit validation endpoints (User Story 3).
**Independent Test**: Validation endpoint returns correct errors/warnings for test lineups.
**Prompt**: `tasks/planned/WP05-validation-api-endpoint.md`

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T028 Create `LineupValidationSerializer` for request/response
- [ ] T029 Create `ValidationResultSerializer` for structured errors/warnings
- [ ] T030 Implement `/validation/lineup/` POST endpoint
- [ ] T031 Implement `/validation/outfit-contrast/` POST endpoint
- [ ] T032 Wire validation views to SportValidationService
- [ ] T033 Add URL routing for validation endpoints

### Constitutional Alignment
- Principle VII (API Design): Clear error messages with field references
- Principle VI (Reliability): Non-blocking validation (warnings allowed)

### Parallel Opportunities
- T028-T29 (serializers) parallel, then T30-T31 (views)

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP02 (services must exist)

### Risks & Mitigations
- Validation performance → Keep validation logic O(n) for lineup size
- Error message clarity → Include field paths in all validation issues

```
WP01 (Models) ──┬──> WP02 (Services)
                │
                ├──> WP03 (Sports API) ────> WP06 (Sports Demo)
                │                                    │
                │                                    v
                ├──> WP04 (Outfit API) ────> WP07 (Outfits Demo)
                │
                └──> WP05 (Validation API) ──> WP08 (Validation Demo)
                                                     │
                                                     v
                                              WP09 (Positions Demo)
                                                     │
                                                     v
                                              WP10 (Polish)
```

- **Sequence**: WP01 → WP02 → WP03-WP05 (parallel possible) → WP06-WP09 → WP10
- **MVP Scope**: WP01 + WP02 + WP03 (Sports API delivers core value)
- **Parallelization**: After WP02, API work packages (WP03-05) can proceed in parallel
